mapper.select: select region_code as code, region_name as name, region_level as level, city_code as cityCode from ry_business.ry_rental_region where parent_code = #{parentCode} and region_level <= 3 and is_delete = 0 order by sort_no, region_code

select region_code as code, parent_code as parentCode, region_level as level, region_name as name, city_code as amapCityCode from ry_business.ry_rental_region where region_level <= 3 and is_delete = 0 order by region_level, sort_no, region_code

select city.region_code as regionCode, city.region_name as regionName, city.region_code as cityCode, city.region_name as cityName, province.region_code as provinceCode, province.region_name as provinceName, city.region_code as weatherAdcode, coalesce(nullif(city.city_code, ''), nullif(province.city_code, '')) as amapCityCode from ry_business.ry_rental_region city left join ry_business.ry_rental_region province on province.region_code = city.parent_code and province.is_delete = 0 where city.region_level = 2 and city.is_delete = 0 order by city.region_code
